subject.title: feat(ui): permanent OpenClaw presence — pinned sidebar entry and Settings dock

question: Should fresh OpenClaw profiles receive the custodian as a default-pinned primary navigation destination while existing saved pin sets remain unchanged?
rationale: This is a deliberate first-use navigation default rather than a mechanical bug fix; tests can prove preservation behavior but cannot choose the product rollout.

options.title: Approve the default pin rollout
options.body: Keep `custodian` in the fresh-profile default pins and retain existing users’ saved pins exactly as the branch currently does.

options.title: Keep custodian discoverable but unpinned
options.body: Retain the Settings and customize-menu entry points while removing the fresh-profile default pin if primary-sidebar prominence is not desired.

recommendation.title: Approve the default pin rollout
recommendation.body: Keep `custodian` in the fresh-profile default pins and retain existing users’ saved pins exactly as the branch currently does.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the linked merged custodian interaction work and this follow-on navigation design.
